llm_response.reason: The website offers Jack Wolfskin-branded products at ridiculously low or even zero prices, demonstrates urgency/psychological sales tactics, and lacks any verifiable company or contact information (no address, phone, or proper legal info). The presence of SSL errors, broken pages for key functions, and copying of a well-known brand identity without official affiliation are all strong indicators. Furthermore, privacy and customer data protection details are ambiguous or missing. These factors collectively match many scam characteristics, identifying this as a likely fake online shop.
